subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these 14 grouped executable-action upgrades after secops reviews the upstream deltas and the rebased exact head completes required checks?
rationale: The patch is mechanically clean, but it changes third-party code executing inside credentialed security, release, and automation jobs; repository ownership policy assigns several touched workflows to secops, and ordinary PR CI cannot exercise every privileged path.

options.title: Approve after security review
options.body: Have secops and the workflow owner verify the upstream action changes, rebase the PR, and merge after required exact-head checks complete.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate Codex, token, Docker publishing, and CodeQL changes from routine setup and housekeeping action bumps for narrower review and rollback.

options.title: Pause grouped upgrade
options.body: Close or defer this grouped PR and allow smaller per-action updates when each privileged workflow can be reviewed independently.

recommendation.title: Approve after security review
recommendation.body: Have secops and the workflow owner verify the upstream action changes, rebase the PR, and merge after required exact-head checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository history shows the strongest cross-cutting ownership of CI, Docker release, Codex-agent workflows, and action-runtime modernization.
